notes.title: Ver 2.0 Major Update
notes.notes:
[h3][IMPORTANT][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new "DLC" content - New Chapter · Celestial Atlas, including 4 new standard levels and one special level.
[*] Added new content - New Chapter · Darkness Descends, including 4 new standard levels. Are you ready for the final battle before dawn?
[*] Added new "DLC" character - Renyi, the Banished Immortal
[*] Added new "DLC" character - Xiaoyu, the Moon Rider
[*] Added Kwent Card Set system, now you can gain additional effects by matching card sets.
[/list]

Here's a detailed description of this update:

[h3][ADDED][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new character - Renyi, the Banished Immortal
[*] Added a new character - Xiaoyu, the Moon Rider
[*] Added a new chapter "Celestial Scroll" - Including levels: Unwavering Brushstrokes; Water Dried, Mountain Broken; Slip Broken, Book Torn; Sky Tilts, Earth Crumbles
[*] Added a new chapter "Darkness Descends" - Including levels: Eternal Silence; Dark Blizzard; Sand in the Night; Long Road's End; Dawn is Here
[*] Added in-level BGM settings
[*] Added 13 new monsters, 4 new Bosses
[*] Added 35 new achievements
[*] Added Lore chapters for all characters
[*] Added Talent nodes for all characters. These new ones can be unlocked by completing the new Lore chapters
[*] Added Card Set system
[*] Added 47 new Kwent Cards: 26 set cards, 19 weapon enhancement cards, 2 character-related cards
[*] Added quick talent upgrade function, players can now directly upgrade to a node by holding the upgrade button
[/list]
[h3][OPTIMIZATIONS][/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized talent unlock reward condition, which is changed from "Unlock Sll Talent Nodes" to "Unlock the Ultimate Node"
[*] Optimized in-game weapon and skill level display effects
[*] Optimized the display effects of the character's charging actions
[/list]

[h3][FIXES][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where Elite and BOSS warnings weren't displaying
[*] Fixed issue where some BOSS warning areas didn't match actual areas
[*] Fixed issue where some localizations weren't displaying correctly
[/list]

notes.title: V1.01 Small Update Lowered Difficulty+Bugfixes
notes.notes:
Based on the feedback of the V1.0 "Ancient Ruins" Major Update, we released this patch to fix the following issues:
[olist]
[*] Optimized the experience of the levels in "Ancient Ruins" by lowering their difficulties. Now players should have a better, smoother and more consistant experience. 
[*] Fixed the bug that caused 3 items in Archive could not be unlocked. 
[*] Added 1-second damage immune time when the character is revived, now character will not die immediate after reviving. 
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the item selection page of Shop and Mage Tower to be skipped if the player enter the battle with mouse&keyboard but switch to a controller before said page pops up.
[/olist]

notes.title: Ver 0.22 Small Update + More Free Content!
notes.notes:
Thank you for your love and support! In order to show our appreciation, we have decided:

For the 2nd Major Update of 2024: Originally planned to add 1 new playable character, we will now add [b]2 new free playable characters[/b].
For the 3rd Major Update of 2024: Originally planned as a [strike]paid DLC[/strike], it will now be a [b]FREE DLC[/b].

In addition to this, we will continue to enrich the game's content and optimize existing features, striving to provide you all with a better experience.

Please allow us to thank you once again for all the love and support!

[h2][April 19 Patch Note][/h2]

[h3][FIXES][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the bug that caused the game to crash when marking locations on the map.
[/list]

[h2]Ver 0.22 Small Update[/h2]

[h3][ADDED][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a marker function (radar). Players can now mark the events they want to go, the marked events will constantly show their direction during gameplay.
[/list]

[h3][OPTIMIZATION][/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized the display location and duration of the button/key hints.
[*] Optimized the interaction logic between gameplay-related keys/buttons and menu-related keys/buttons; now, they should not conflict with each other anymore.
[*] Optimized the control effect of the visual effects transparency slider; now, this function will correctly control the special effects that should be reduced in transparency.
[*] Optimized the curve of the visual effect transparency slider, now adjusting transparency is smoother visually.
[*] Optimized part of the conditions for "Lore." Now players should be able to complete "Lore" more easily.
- Augustine #3.2 3000 -> 1000
- Elena #1.1 500 -> 300
#2.2 10 -> 5
#3.1 300 -> 100
- Aldreya #1-2 500 -> 50
#2.1 500 -> 100
- Inu Kage #1.2 100 -> 20
#3.2 50 -> 30
- Lilia #3.1 200 -> 100
#3.2 2000 -> 1000
- Aster #1-2 100 -> 20
#2.1 Clear -> Defeat 40 black bears
#2.2 Clear -> Defeat 50 mammoths
- Doridori #3.1 300 -> 100
#3.2 300 -> 75
[/list]

[h3][FIXES][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the enemy "Earth Devourer" occasionally behaves abnormally.
[*] Fixed the issue where the skip function for the opening animation of "Goddess of Fate's Blessings" occasionally stops working.
[*] Fixed an issue where moving horizontally/vertically was slower than moving diagonally.
[/list]

notes.title: Ver 0.21 Small Update
notes.notes:
[h3][ADDED][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a weapon visual effects transparency slider, players can now adjust the transparency of the visual effects in the Options.
[*] Added an auto-aim toggle and removed the auto-aim Kwent Cards. Players can now turn auto-aim on/off in real-time in the game.
[*] Added a damage number display toggle, which is enabled by default. Players can choose to disable the display of damage numbers in the Options.
[*] Added a function to claim all achievement rewards with one click/press/tab.
[*] Added a character voice volume slider.
[*] Added an Archive Entry: Pickups - "Kwent Card"
[*] 
[/list]
[h3][OPTIMIZATION][/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized monster death effect (thanks to every monster that made the sacrifice during our effect adjustment).
[*] Optimized the turning speed of the Flamethrower, players can now aim at targets faster.
[*] Optimized the opening animation of "Goddess of Fate's Blessings", which now prompts players to skip it with text.
[*] Optimized the reward page of "Goddess of Fate's Blessings", players can now claim rewards by clicking "COLLECT" with the mouse or pressing the "Space" key.
[*] Optimized the animation performance of Lilia's exclusive weapon to synchronize it with the skill activation timing.
[/list]

[h3][FIXES][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the universal weapon "Call of the Wild" caused summoned creature damage to be ineffective.
[*] Fixed an issue where turning off the "Show Warning Message" in the settings did not work.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Archive Entry for the enemy "Goblin Treasure Raider" displayed an incorrect image.
[*] Fixed a crash caused by the trinket "Will of Anubis."
[*] Fixed an issue where the trinket "Will of the Penguin King" prevented the character from dashing/using special skills.
[*] Fixed an issue where the cooldowns for the Kwent Cards "Hire Minions - Melee" and "Hire Minions - Ranged" were incorrect.
[/list]
